title: GnollHack performance suite manifest
description: suite.json: one in-app Performance Suite, written by GHPerformanceSuiteStore next to the suite's run records (run-record.schema.json). It never has a top-level schemaVersion, smoothness or series property, so the offline analyzer never mistakes it for a run record. Doubles are written as 0 where the value was NaN or infinite, except in a run's background object, where null marks a signal the platform did not report.

suiteId.description: yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_<scenario>_<device model>, in UTC; a numeric suffix is added on collision. Equal to the suite's folder name

environment.description: The environment captured when the suite's first window (warm-up or run 1) ended, so values set on the first paint and the render adapter are present; the one written when the suite is created is provisional until then

fingerprintAtEnd.description: The fingerprint re-captured when the suite finished; absent before that, and when the capture failed

environmentChanged.description: Whether fingerprintAtEnd differs from environment.fingerprint in a key outside meta and code (changed, added or removed); absent when either fingerprint is missing

comparabilityKey.description: scenario|replaySha256|startTurn|pageMode|mapRefreshRateSetting|round(measuredRefreshHz)|m<metricsVersion>, the last part being GHSmoothnessMetrics.MetricsVersion of the app that finished the suite (absent in keys written before metrics version 2, so such suites match none written after), followed by |tg=<thermalGate>,<thermalWaitSeconds> unless those are start and 300; set when the suite finishes. Suites are compared only within one key

measuredRefreshHz.description: Nearest-rank median over the used runs' values above 0 (over every run with a summary in manifests finished by older builds); 0 when there is none

targetFps.description: Nearest-rank median over the used runs' values above 0 (over every run with a summary in manifests finished by older builds); 0 when there is none

runs.description: Measured runs, not counting the warm-up run

thermalGate.description: What each thermal gate after the first run waits for: start, a status no worse than the suite-start reading; light, Light or better. Absent in suites recorded before the setting existed, which behaved as start

thermalWaitSeconds.description: The longest each thermal gate waits, the one before the first run included; 0 means no thermal wait. Absent in suites recorded before the setting existed, which waited at most 300 s

fingerprint.description: The environment fingerprint when the suite's first window ended (at its creation until then); absent in manifests written before fingerprints existed
The environment fingerprint (GHEnvironmentFingerprint), as in run-record.schema.json: flat "<category>.<name>" keys with string values

index.description: 0 is the warm-up run when the suite has one

runFile.description: File name of the run record, alongside suite.json; null when the run produced no record

turnAtWindowStart.description: Replay turn when the window opened; absent when unknown and in manifests written before it existed

inputRecordsInWindow.description: Replay input records played during the window, the playback content measured; absent when unknown and in manifests written before it existed

excludedReason.description: Null when the run is used

notes.description: Free text about the run, e.g. "quiet gate timed out (other CPU 14 %)"; absent when there is none

runBackground.description: The run's background verdict and headline window values from its record's background block; absent when the run has no background report

otherCpuP90Pct.description: Machine CPU minus the app, of total logical capacity

summary.description: The part of GHSmoothnessSummary the suite report and the comparison use

metricsVersion.description: GHSmoothnessMetrics.MetricsVersion of the analysis; absent or 0 means 1; version 3 adds compositorCoverage and syncOffsetP50Ms; version 4 corrects stale Android vsync times (vsyncCorrectedShare)

forcedGcCount.description: Display callbacks that followed a collection the app forced (GHFrameFlags.ForcedCollection)

compositorReportsLost.description: FrameMetrics reports the listener missed (Android); not display drops

compositorCoverage.description: The share of GL-thread paints carried by a FrameMetrics report (Android); null elsewhere

vsyncCorrectedShare.description: Android: share of ticks whose Choreographer frame time was one refresh behind HWUI's and was corrected; null elsewhere

longStallCount.description: Gaps in which display callbacks stopped for 1 s or more; counted as hitches in a suite run

causeCount.description: Indexed by GHHitchCause; hitches and judder frames alike

causeHitchCount.description: Indexed by GHHitchCause; of causeCount, the hitches alone. Absent before metrics version 2
